questions.question: Write 3,68 in expanded form and say what the 6 is worth.
questions.expected_answer: 3,68 = 3 + 0,6 + 0,08. The 6 is in the tenths place, so it is worth 0,6, which is 6/10.

questions.question: Explain why 7/100 is written as 0,07 and not 0,7.
questions.expected_answer: Hundredths are the second place after the comma, so the 7 goes in the second place. The 0 holds the empty tenths place. 0,7 would mean 7 tenths, which is ten times bigger.

questions.question: Count forwards in tenths from 2,7 for four steps. Explain what happens after 2,9.
questions.expected_answer: 2,8; 2,9; 3,0; 3,1. After 2,9, one more tenth makes 10 tenths, which is a whole, so the tenths go back to 0 and the units go up from 2 to 3.
